description: React functional component implementing a detailed workflow identity dashboard, including credential verification status, credential details, workflow path, and DID resolution bundle. It imports UI components, utility functions, and API services to render and handle interactions related to verifiable credentials and decentralized identifiers.

methods.name: getStatusBadgeVariant
methods.description: Maps a normalized execution status to a badge variant (e.g., success, failed, etc.).

methods.name: getStatusIconConfig
methods.description: Returns icon component and class configuration based on normalized status.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats an ISO date string into a human-readable date and time string.

methods.name: formatRelativeTime
methods.description: Calculates and formats a relative time string from a given date string, e.g., '5 minutes ago'.

methods.name: EnhancedWorkflowIdentity
methods.description: React component rendering workflow identity details, credential verification, credential details, workflow path, and DID bundle, with interaction handlers for exporting, downloading, and copying credentials and DID data.
